is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F), N1575Y, I1527T, and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (pages 9-11, Tables 2-5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2, 3, 4, and 5 provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for the markers across different study sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from six villages in the Maferinyah sub-prefecture, Forecariah Prefecture, Guinea (page 3, page 15).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted by the authors.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for six specific villages: Fandie, Madinagbe, Maferinyah Centre I, Moribayah, Senguelen, and Yindi (page 3, Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling was conducted between 22nd June and 17th July 2017 (page 15).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes in 2017.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance and malaria infection in Anopheles gambiae s.l. from six villages in Forecariah Prefecture, Guinea. It reports high levels of pyrethroid resistance and the presence of L1014F, N1575Y, I1527T, and G119S Ace-1 mutations, providing genotype counts for these markers.
